title: Baker Victory Services day treatment center as a front for defense psychic research
place_text: 650 Ridge Road, Western New York (Baker Victory Services)

tellings.quote: And that game began a two-year journey to where I attended school into a uh nondescript uh since been shut down, sued six ways to Sunday uh school that was from the outside serving neurode divergent um and behavioral health kids uh but on the inside was supporting um a mission for defense contractor research for psychic potential uh development.

plain: A school at 650 Ridge Road in Western New York, run by Baker Victory Services, outwardly served neurodivergent children and kids with behavioral health needs but secretly supported "defense contractor research for psychic potential development," according to a man named Jordan Jose, who says he was a pupil there from about 2008 to 2010. Jose says a game he played as a child began "a two-year journey" that put him in that school, which he says has "since been shut down, sued six ways to Sunday." If true, children were being tested for psychic abilities under cover of a school.
